text: At d_model=128 on data_seed 1, seed 22's N=64 layer-1 accel_step headroom-normalised margin (0.738) exceeds N=128's (0.654) by 0.084, while its force gap is 0.065. Across all paired N=64/N=128 seeds and widths, does the per-seed layer-1 force gap track the per-seed layer-1 accel_step normalised-margin gap? That would suggest the N=128 deficit is a general layer-1 decodability shortfall rather than one specific to force.
